title: Tomato 'Oh Happy Days' - 2x Mini Plug Plants – Blight Resistant, High Yield
description:
‘Oh Happy Days’ is a hybrid variety that combines strong blight resistance from North American breeding with the rich flavour typical of French Marmande tomatoes.


 This variety produces round fruits weighing up to 150g, usually forming in clusters of 3 to 7. It is a cordon (indeterminate) salad tomato suitable for growing in a greenhouse or outdoors. Plants are reliable and produce heavy crops of large red tomatoes with good disease resistance.


 Key features:


  Variety: Oh Happy Days
 

  Type: Indeterminate (cordon – requires support)
 

  Fruit: Round, red tomatoes up to 150g
 

  Trusses: Typically 3–7 fruits per cluster
 

  Flavour: Rich, Marmande-style
 

  Good blight resistance
 

  Heavy cropping
 

 Growing information:


  Suitable for greenhouse or outdoor growing
 

  Requires support (cordon type)
 

  Best grown in a warm, sunny position
 

  Plant in fertile, well-drained soil
 

  Water regularly and feed as plants establish
